notes: Declared thresholds for P5's rights detectors (R4, ADR-0034). Loaded and validated by quality_gate.detectors.config.load_detector_policy.

audio_fingerprint: spectral-landmark (peak-pair) hashing in numpy/scipy. Any change to a parameter changes the fingerprint version (algorithm_version plus a hash of the parameters), and stored fingerprints of another version are not compared: the source is then UNKNOWN until it is re-fingerprinted.

audio decision: MATCH when at least match_min_aligned_hashes candidate hashes agree on one time offset (within offset_tolerance_frames) AND that count divided by the smaller of the two fingerprints' hash counts is at least match_min_score. A candidate with fewer than min_candidate_hashes hashes is inconclusive (UNKNOWN).

lyric_similarity: word shingles of shingle_size tokens after the shared normalisation (plm_platform.protected_artists.normalise_for_screening), hashed with blake2b-64. score = max(containment of the candidate in the reference, coverage of the reference by the candidate). MATCH when score >= match_min_score OR the shared shingle count >= match_min_shared_shingles. Fewer than min_candidate_shingles candidate shingles is inconclusive (UNKNOWN).

Calibration: thresholds were set on deterministic synthetic fixtures (tests/unit/test_qa_detectors_*.py), not on a labelled corpus of real music. They are risk signals, not proof of originality (docs/STATUS.md 'Detector limitations').
